mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over the past six months indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances with positive GDP growth, or GDP growth and 60-day returns show a negative correlation (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% within the last two months signals increased economic activity and corporate output, which boosts investor confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts by more than 5% within the last two months signals a weakening in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer demand and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between HOUST decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.5% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.5% within the last two months, it signals inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 2 months
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL on negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.3% within the last month, it signals a strong labor market and economic growth, which boosts investor confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real retail and food services sales by more than 1% over the past month signals increased consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances with positive RSAFS growth, or RSAFS growth and 20-day returns show a negative correlation (p < 0.05).
